name: analyze-document
description: Analyse attached documents (a report, a manual, a scientific article, a policy) with the analysis procedures of a base memory: first ingest each document into a session or a base memory (ingestion v2, with provenance: document, location, quote), then run the procedures over that document's wires (contradictions, numeric and temporal consistency, claims without support, KPIs, a quality rubric), then report the findings with the document's own words. Use when the user asks to check, audit, review or evaluate a document for errors or inconsistencies, or to compute its indicators.

rights.description: the source rights of the attachments, as the user stated them (DS011); required: without it nothing is ingested or analysed

purpose.description: what the analysis is for, in the user's words

procedures.description: the analysis procedures to run (ids of procedure wires tagged analysis); default: every analysis procedure of the memory

base.description: target none: the base memory of the new session the documents are ingested into (it must hold analysis procedures; analysis-core-v1 is created when missing)

tier.description: the tier of the ingestion's structure role

fol_tier.description: the tier of the ingestion's FOL role and its repair (default medium, with reasoning)

merge_tier.description: the tier that decides the conflicts of the ingestion's canonical vocabulary

max_chunk_bytes.description: the largest chunk of a document handled in one call (default 3000)

reasoning.description: the engine of the analysis queries: auto (the StrategyRouter) or one engine id run exactly

_note: Wraps two product functions: ingestV2 (lib/ingest/v2: structure role, canonical vocabulary, FOL per sentence, converter, validator, contradiction and quote checks, storage with provenance) and analyzeSession (lib/analysis: the procedures' members over the document layer and its view, the StrategyRouter, the oracle's proofs). Writes, per document, <taskDir>/analysis/<document>/analysis.json and report.md, plus ingest-v2/ for the ingestion's files.
